verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Wise Business offers APIs for payments, cards, balances, statements (JSON/CSV/PDF/XLSX/CAMT.053/MT940/QIF) and webhooks, but there is no mention of any ERP connector, accounting-sync integration, or bidirectional journal-entry sync with systems like QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or SAP. Missing for 10: any ERP/accounting-software integration, evidence of automated journal entry creation, or bidirectional sync capability.
